meta.title: 数字化转型会触动利益链｜落地阻力
meta.title_en: Digital Transparency Threatens Hidden Interest Chains

scenes.title_cn: 透明化动了利益链的蛋糕
scenes.title_en: Transparency threatens the chain of interests
scenes.context: 讲者点出第三点：数字化转型会让一切变透明，而传统企业恰恰靠不透明生存——利益链是最大的落地阻力。
sentences: 第三点，数字化转型会让很多东西变透明，而传统企业里面最多的就是利益链。
Third point: digital transformation makes a lot of things transparent—and traditional companies are full of chains of interest.
利益链：chain of interest
不透明才是他们能生存的真正原因，透明了，大家都没有利益可拿。
It's the opacity that keeps them alive; once everything is transparent, there's nothing in it for them.
没有利益可拿：there's nothing in it for them
传统企业工资很低，他们怎么挣钱？就是从采购、运输、生产、销售每个环节的预算和关系里捞好处。
Traditional companies pay low salaries, so how do people make extra money? By skimming benefits from budgets and connections across procurement, logistics, production, and sales.
捞好处：skim benefits / line one's pockets
paraphrase: 透明化 → 利益藏不住
每个环节捞好处 → 就是利益链
Skimming at every link is what the chain of interest is.
scenes.speak: Third point: digital transformation makes a lot of things transparent—and traditional companies are full of chains of interest. It's the opacity that keeps them alive; once everything is transparent, there's nothing in it for them. Traditional companies pay low salaries, so how do people make extra money? By skimming benefits from budgets and connections across procurement, logistics, production, and sales.

scenes.title_cn: 大老板要反，但业务不配合
scenes.title_en: The boss wants to crack down, but the business won't play along
scenes.context: 大老板要用数字化反利益链，但系统落地需要业务部门配合；业务部门知道系统一上，自己的利益就藏不住了，凭什么配合你？
sentences: 大老板肯定不高兴，说要搞数字化、信息化，反的就是这些东西。
The big boss is definitely unhappy, so he wants digital and information systems to crack down on exactly these practices.
反的就是这些：crack down on exactly these practices
但我问你：你做完这个系统，怎么落地？是不是需要业务部门配合你？
But let me ask you: once you build the system, how does it actually get rolled out? Doesn't it need the business units to cooperate?
落地：get rolled out
他知道你是来搞他的，做完以后他就藏不住那些利益了，他为什么要配合你？
He knows you're out to get him—once the system is live, he can't hide those gains anymore. So why on earth would he help you roll it out?
藏不住利益：can't hide the gains anymore
paraphrase: 反利益链 → 大老板的算盘
Cracking down on interest chains is the boss's agenda.
系统落地 → 业务配合是命门
Rollout lives or dies by business cooperation.
scenes.speak: The big boss is definitely unhappy, so he wants digital and information systems to crack down on exactly these practices. But let me ask you: once you build the system, how does it actually get rolled out? Doesn't it need the business units to cooperate? He knows you're out to get him—once the system is live, he can't hide those gains anymore. So why on earth would he help you roll it out?

scenes.title_cn: 一场漫长的战役：攒势能、等时机
scenes.title_en: A long campaign: build momentum and wait for the window
scenes.context: 所以第二个忠告才是「低调」——高高在上没人跟你合作。这是场漫长战役，只能慢慢积累势能、系统、关系、认知，等关键机会一到再全面铺开。
sentences: 所以你明白我为什么让你们低调了吗？你高高在上，一定死，所有人不会跟你合作。
Now you see why I told you to keep a low profile? Act high and mighty and you're dead—nobody will work with you.
高高在上：act high and mighty
如果你真想去一家传统企业做数字化转型，这是一场漫长的战役。
If you really want to drive digital transformation in a traditional company, it's a long, drawn-out campaign.
漫长的战役：a long, drawn-out campaign
你只能慢慢积累势能、系统、关系、认知，不断跟上司互动，等那个关键机会一到，一下就把它铺开。
You can only slowly build momentum, polish your system, nurture relationships, deepen your understanding, and keep engaging your boss—until that critical window opens and you roll it all out at once.
积累势能：build momentum
paraphrase: 高高在上 → 没人合作
强行推进 → 慢慢蓄力
scenes.speak: Now you see why I told you to keep a low profile? Act high and mighty and you're dead—nobody will work with you. If you really want to drive digital transformation in a traditional company, it's a long, drawn-out campaign. You can only slowly build momentum, polish your system, nurture relationships, deepen your understanding, and keep engaging your boss—until that critical window opens and you roll it all out at once.

scenes.title_cn: 机会来自「存亡之秋」，话要说得好听
scenes.title_en: The window is a survival crisis; frame the pitch as help
scenes.context: 机会来自公司遭遇生存危机的「存亡之秋」，那时没人敢反对；平稳期就得有耐心。跟业务沟通不能说真话，要说「我们是来帮你们的」。
sentences: 那机会从哪来？存亡之秋——公司遇到了生存问题，大家抱团取暖，都为共同目标努力。
So where does that window come from? A moment of survival crisis—when the company faces existential trouble, everyone huddles together and works toward one shared goal.
存亡之秋：a moment of survival crisis
跟业务沟通时我们不能说真话，不能说「上了系统，高层就能更苛刻地管理你们」。
When we talk to the business units, we can't tell them the whole story—we can't say “once the system is in, management will keep a tighter leash on you.”
更苛刻地管理：keep a tighter leash on
我们要讲的是：我们是来帮你们的，是为了让高层不要误解你们、以为你们啥也没干。这才是核心。
Instead we say: we're here to help you, to make sure management doesn't get the wrong idea that you've done nothing at all. That's the real core of it.
不要误解你们：make sure they don't get the wrong idea
paraphrase: 生存危机 → 最佳窗口
A survival crisis is the perfect window.
直说目的 → 包装成帮忙
Frame the pitch as help, not surveillance.
scenes.speak: So where does that window come from? A moment of survival crisis—when the company faces existential trouble, everyone huddles together and works toward one shared goal. That's when rolling out your plan is easiest, because nobody dares to object. But when we talk to the business units, we can't tell them the whole story. Instead we say: we're here to help you, to make sure management doesn't get the wrong idea that you've done nothing at all. That's the real core of it.

practice: Digital transformation threatens the hidden chains of interest.
How do we actually roll out this system without business buy-in?
Driving digital change here is a long, drawn-out campaign.
Frame the pitch as helping them, not spying on them.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Transparent, everyone has no interest to take.
✓ 地道说法：Once it's all transparent, there's nothing in it for them.
「没有利益可拿」不能直译，nothing in it for someone 是地道口语。
✕ 直译腔：How does the system land?
✓ 地道说法：How do we actually roll out the system?
「落地」是实施的意思，用 roll out / implement，不能直译 land。
✕ 直译腔：You are high above, you will die.
✓ 地道说法：Act high and mighty, and you're dead in the water.
「高高在上」对应 high and mighty；「一定死」口语说 dead in the water。
✕ 直译腔：We can't say the true words.
✓ 地道说法：We can't tell them the whole story.
「真话」对应 the whole story / the full picture，比 true words 地道。
shifts: 以为数字化转型是「技术问题」
数字化转型首先撞上的是「利益问题」
以为系统上线就大功告成
系统上线只是开始，业务不配合就无法落地
以为「真诚直说」能换来信任
要先把目的包装成「帮忙」，才能换来配合
